title: Garmin fails to sync activity epochs with Connect
shortDescription: Activity data or steps do not upload to Garmin Connect.
fullDescription:
Garmin devices upload rolling epoch data (steps, heart rate samples) alongside completed activities. Sync failures usually come from Bluetooth connection issues with the phone, out-of-date Garmin Connect app, or server-side congestion.

Force sync from the watch (Menu > Connect), restart Bluetooth on the phone, and update both Garmin Connect and Garmin Express.

A persistent sync failure over 24h should be escalated to Garmin support with the device's unit ID.

fixSteps.title: Update app
fixSteps.instruction: Update Garmin Connect in App Store/Play.

title: Garmin cannot acquire GPS / stuck searching
shortDescription: Watch hangs on satellite search before activity start.
fullDescription:
GPS acquisition can take up to 3 minutes when GPS almanac (ephemeris) data is stale. Keeping the watch outdoors with clear sky view and syncing with Connect pre-downloads CIQ EPO/satellite prediction data for faster fixes.

Stale data is common after 7+ days without sync. Also avoid buildings, dense trees, and wet sleeves.

fixSteps.title: Sync Connect
fixSteps.instruction: Sync to download fresh EPO data.

fixSteps.title: Stand outdoors
fixSteps.instruction: Hold watch face up, clear sky, 3-5 minutes.

title: Garmin not recognized when connected via USB
shortDescription: Computer or Garmin Express cannot see the watch when plugged in.
fullDescription: USB recognition requires a data-capable cable and a clean contact on the charging clip. Charge-only cables, debris on pins, and locked screens prevent detection. Use Garmin's original cable and verify in Garmin Express.

fixSteps.title: Clean pins
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe watch pins with isopropyl alcohol.

fixSteps.title: Try another cable/port
fixSteps.instruction: Use Garmin-supplied cable on different USB port.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall Garmin Express
fixSteps.instruction: Reinstall Garmin Express to refresh drivers.

title: Garmin watch will not charge
shortDescription: Battery icon does not appear or charge stays at 0%.
fullDescription: Non-charging usually means dirty charging contacts or a stuck charging clip. Occasionally, a deeply discharged battery needs 15-30 minutes before any progress shows. If the device stays at 0% after 60 min on a known-good cable, warranty service is required.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Isopropyl alcohol on pins, dry fully.

fixSteps.title: Wait 60 min
fixSteps.instruction: Leave on charger 60 min even with no indicator.

title: Garmin display frozen / unresponsive
shortDescription: Screen locks up and buttons do nothing.
fullDescription: A soft reset clears most freezes. Hold the power button 15-30 seconds to force a reboot. On touch models, also try a hard reset (hold power 30s, release, then hold again to power on).

fixSteps.title: Force reboot
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power button 15-30s until watch restarts.

title: Garmin optical HR not reading
shortDescription: Wrist-based HR shows dashes or locks to low BPM.
fullDescription: Elevate HR sensor needs firm skin contact. Wear tight, one finger-width above the wrist bone. Dirty sensor, arm hair, or cold skin causes inaccurate readings. Persistent issues after tightening band may need sensor reseat via warranty.

title: Garmin won't pair with phone over Bluetooth
shortDescription: Pair attempt in Garmin Connect times out.
fullDescription: Pairing fails if watch is already paired to another phone, Bluetooth cache is stale, or permissions are denied. Remove any existing pairing, clear Connect's Bluetooth cache, and grant location permission (required for BLE scan).

fixSteps.title: Grant permissions
fixSteps.instruction: Grant Bluetooth, Location, Nearby Devices to Connect.

title: Garmin altimeter readings drifted
shortDescription: Elevation readings off by tens of meters.
fullDescription: Barometric altimeters drift with weather changes. Calibrate manually at a known elevation or enable auto-calibration with GPS. Clean the pressure port if blocked by sweat or dust.

fixSteps.title: Rinse watch
fixSteps.instruction: Rinse with fresh water to clear pressure port.

title: Garmin stuck on boot logo
shortDescription: Watch does not progress past the Garmin splash screen.
fullDescription: A failed firmware update can hang boot. Garmin publishes a forced-firmware-load procedure using Garmin Express with the device in mass storage mode. Hold power while connecting to PC to enter recovery.

fixSteps.title: Mass storage recovery
fixSteps.instruction: Hold power while plugging into PC; drop firmware via Garmin Express.

title: Garmin physical buttons not responding
shortDescription: One or more buttons stop registering presses.
fullDescription: Sweat and salt corrode buttons over time. Rinse under warm water and actuate the button while submerged. Persistent failure requires warranty service — buttons are sealed units and not user-serviceable.

fixSteps.title: Rinse and actuate
fixSteps.instruction: Warm water rinse, press button 20 times underwater.
